name: shadcn-stacked-progress-bar
summary: Composable stacked progress bar for shadcn/ui that shows multiple statuses in one track, with legend and tooltips.
description: A stacked progress bar component for shadcn/ui that displays multiple sequential or categorical statuses in a single track. It ships composable sub-components for the bar, segments, legends and labels, optional interactive tooltips and full ARIA semantics (role=progressbar, aria-valuenow/min/max). Installs from the shadcn registry as item stacked-progress-bar or by copying one file; requires React 19 and a shadcn project with Tailwind.
contains: stacked progress bar with multiple segments in one track
composable parts: provider, track, segment, legend, legend item
optional interactive legend and multi-segment tooltips
shadcn registry item stacked-progress-bar; single-file install
requires React 19 and Tailwind; CVA styling with dark mode
